description.en: Washington is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is commonly referred to as Washington state to distinguish it from the national capital; both are named after George Washington, a U.S. Founding Father and the first U.S. president.
description.zh-CN: 华盛顿州，简称华州，是一個位於美国西北太平洋沿岸的州。北接加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省，南接俄勒岡州，東臨愛達荷州，西鄰太平洋。
description.zh-TW: 華盛頓州，簡稱華州，是一個位於美國西北太平洋沿岸的州。北接加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省，南接俄勒岡州，東臨愛達荷州，西鄰太平洋。
